links.outcome: Feasibility of custom anonymization of medical letters for GDPR-compliant LLM fine-tuning
links.effect: A dataset of around 60,000 medical letters was anonymized with a custom algorithm for GDPR compliance; authors conclude regulatory challenges with patient data can effectively be dealt with.
links.quote: Our anonymization process showed that regulatory challenges in the context of AI with patient data can effectively be dealt with.

unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning a commercial LLM on locally anonymized clinical letters to generate ophthalmology epicrises
Comparing time to correct AI drafts versus write documentation manually

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates a fine-tuned LLM (Curie) for generating ophthalmic discharge summaries (epicrises), measuring documentation time reduction and correctness via human and LLM evaluation.
